files.title: Files synced to Cloud
files.description: Web supports readonly access to existing cloud files. If a file needs local processing, continue in the app.

messages.uploadReadFailed: Couldn't read the selected file(s). Please try again.

recentFiles.title: Recent files
recentFiles.description: Open recent cloud files with the formal attachment viewer. Complex media still follows the readonly Continue in App policy.

open.title: Open the web app
open.signedOutBody: Sign in to continue into SecondLoop Web. Managed Pro is required for web access.
open.signedInBody: Your account is ready. Continue below to check access and enter SecondLoop Web.

subscribe.title: Subscribe for web access
subscribe.signedOutBody: Sign in first, then start Managed Pro to unlock web access.
subscribe.signedInBody: You're signed in. Continue below to start Managed Pro and unlock web access.

manage.title: Manage your subscription
manage.signedOutBody: Sign in first, then use the billing controls to manage your subscription.
manage.signedInBody: You're signed in. Continue below to manage billing or confirm your current access.

mediaProcessing.title: Continue processing in the app
mediaProcessing.description: Existing cloud results stay available here. If a file still needs OCR, decoding, or transcoding, open it in the app to continue processing.
